opening.argument: The video presents a smart-contract flash-loan method as a way to earn MATIC, pairing setup instructions with unusually large claimed returns. It tells viewers to connect MetaMask, “Send $200 of MATIC to the contract for gas fee for all swaps,” and “Call 'flashloan' function in Remix.” The speaker says the process could produce “four five six seven eight X” and reports, “So, a little over $200 to $1496. I just did a 7x.” Although the description says, “This worked for me. But TRY IT AT YOUR OWN RISK!”, and the speaker acknowledges it “probably won't work forever,” those qualifications do not remove the direct solicitation to fund and deploy the contract or the stated relationship between that process and substantial returns. Independent verification is absent.
